caption: The drawing depicts a two-story house with a large front porch and a tall red brick chimney. The house is painted in light colors, primarily white and beige, with dark trim around the windows and railings. In the foreground, there is a black iron gate with brick pillars on either side, which is part of a black iron fence that stretches horizontally across the scene. There is a short set of steps leading from the sidewalk to the gate, and another set of steps from the yard up to the house porch. The front yard is covered in green grass with two large, leafy green trees situated prominently in front of the house, partially obscuring the structure. Below the porch, there is a bed of colorful flowers with red, purple, and yellow hues. The sidewalk and street are drawn in gray, with paving lines visible. The sky and background are left uncolored, showing the natural off-white color of the paper. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Mr. Stewart's House
